sliding_window.down_scope_rule: Sliding-window runs at the FULL prereg shots/cell, like every other decoder. To measure realistic cost, cost-probe the streaming decoder on 400 shots on the first cell and fit the affine model total = startup(~1s) + per_shot * n, so the projection uses the AMORTIZED marginal per-shot rate (NOT the startup-dominated per-probe-shot number). The time cap (1200s/cell) is a generous backstop that is NOT expected to fire at the amortized rate. If a cell's projected wall-time ever exceeds the cap, that cell's sliding-window is down-scoped to the failure-target shot count for its p (enough shots for ~300 failures at the pilot LER, floored to 1000), recorded as sliding_window_shots + a note. No other decoder is ever down-scoped.
